text:
tila: Quick ping 1 akshay starts Wed. dropping a short who-to-ask thread for day1 stuff: access, trainings, and who to page for incidents.

akshay: thanks! a few things I couldn't find in the new-hire doc: production DB read access, SOC2 onboarding, and a mentor for the first sprint.

jamie: hey @akshay 1 for security trainings and SOC2 checklist ping people-ops and me. Security runs the chart: https://wiki/redwood/security/onboarding-soc2. You'll need to finish module 1 and 2 before prod creds.

people-ops: @akshay noted 1 we handle trainings & badge collection. I'll DM the enrollment link and schedule the HR intro.

marco: infra notes: DB read access is a two-step: group membership + short-lived creds. File a request at https://intranet/redwood/access-requests with service names and reason. Put "day1: read" in the subject for priority.

akshay: thanks Marcos. who is the owner for the analytics DB (redwood-analytics-prod)?

marco: owner is analytics-svc team. I'll add @data-ops alias to the ticket so they can approve. If you need write later, it'll need a manager sign-off.

tila: mentor: @jamie suggested pairing with jamie for security adjacencies, but for product work you should be assigned to a buddy. @mentor-bot will assign a buddy this afternoon.

mentor-bot: Buddy assigned: jamie (security) for cross-team onboarding and paula for product pairing. Welcome aboard!

akshay: perfect. one more: oncall and who to page if a customer-facing latency spike hits Dedicated routing?

marco: primary oncall for Dedicated is eng-dedicated this week: marco => backup paula. page #eng-oncall or use the pager link in the wiki. If it's a customer-impacting SEV, follow the incident runbook and @oncall-manager will escalate to platform leads.

jamie: small security note: if you ever find exposed secrets, do not post in slack. Use the incident form: https://security-forms/redwood/sev-secret and alert security privately.

people-ops: badge pickup: fill this form https://intranet/redwood/badges, then schedule at campus kiosks. HR will email you a window.

akshay: got it. last question: repo access and CI keys?

marco: for repos, ping the repo-access bot or file a repo request. CI tokens are granted after your GitHub org invite and passing the basic trainings. Put repo list in the access request ticket.

tila: summary I'll DM you the checklist: badge link, access-request URL, SOC2 modules, oncall rota, buddy names, and the analytics owner contact. Anything else @akshay?

akshay: that's everything for now 1 appreciate the quick answers. see you Wed! :smile:

tila: Welcome! we'll keep the thread open if other short asks pop up.
